name: Nordic Standard Admin Chat for ChatGPT
author: nordicstandard

sections.description:
Nordic Standard Admin Chat for ChatGPT brings the power of ChatGPT directly into your WordPress admin area. This admin-only plugin provides a clean, intuitive interface for interacting with OpenAI’s ChatGPT using your own API key.

Key Features:

  • Admin-Only Access – Secure interface accessible only to administrators
  • Multiple Chat Sessions – Create, manage, and switch between different conversations
  • Rich Formatting – Full markdown support with syntax highlighting for code blocks
  • Persistent Storage – All chat conversations are saved and persist across sessions
  • Clean Interface – Simple, user-friendly chat interface integrated into wp-admin
  • Your Own API Key – Use your personal OpenAI API key for full control

Perfect For:

  • Content creation and brainstorming
  • Code assistance and debugging
  • Quick research and information lookup
  • Writing assistance
  • Technical documentation help

External services

This plugin connects to the OpenAI API (https://api.openai.com) to provide ChatGPT functionality in the WordPress admin area.

Data sent: When you use the chat, your prompts and conversation history are sent to the OpenAI API for processing. No other user data is sent.

Service provider: OpenAI, L.P.
Terms of Service: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/nordic-standard-admin-chat-for-chatgpt directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Admin Chat > Settings in your WordPress admin menu.
  4. Enter your OpenAI API key in the settings page.
  5. Start chatting with ChatGPT from the Admin Chat menu!
sections.faq:
Do I need an OpenAI API key?

Yes, you need your own OpenAI API key. You can get one from https://platform.openai.com/api-keys

Is this plugin free?

The plugin is free, but you’ll need to pay for OpenAI API usage based on your usage. Check OpenAI’s pricing for current rates.

Who can access the chat interface?

Only WordPress administrators (users with ‘manage_options’ capability) can access the chat interface.

Are my conversations saved?

Yes, all chat conversations are saved in your WordPress database and persist across sessions.

Can I have multiple chat sessions?

Yes, you can create multiple chat sessions and switch between them easily.
